title: Identification of bacterial spores by Raman and OPTIR spectroscopy coupled with machine learning

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Identification of bacterial spores by Raman and OPTIR spectroscopy coupled with machine learning》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Accurate identification of bacterial endospores is essential for contamination tracing in the food industry; however, rapid species-level discrimination remains difficult with conventional methods.

evidence.text: Accurate identification of bacterial endospores is essential for contamination tracing in the food industry; however, rapid species-level discrimination remains difficult with conventional methods.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Identification of bacterial spores by Raman and OPTIR spectroscopy coupled with machine learning》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Among the tested representations, the concatenated Raman + OPTIR model achieved the best external performance, with a mean overall accuracy of 87.26%, balanced accuracy of 86.82%, and macro-F1 score of 86.73%, outperforming Raman alone, OPTIR alone, and the support vector machine baseline.

evidence.text: Among the tested representations, the concatenated Raman + OPTIR model achieved the best external performance, with a mean overall accuracy of 87.26%, balanced accuracy of 86.82%, and macro-F1 score of 86.73%, outperforming Raman alone, OPTIR alone, and the support vector machine baseline.
